scope: independent H100 long/misaligned contiguous fused_dropout recordings; vector width inferred from observed pointer metadata plus the pinned primary source, never from profiler kernel labels; tests only
statement: These five files are byte-identical copies of the host dropout-layout recording (reference/dropout-layout-study/holdouts). They are diagnostic test oracles used only by test/rng_parity/test_cuda_compat_dropout.py to replay the CUDA fused_dropout mask bits, the Philox offset pair and the vector width the pinned source selects; no product code imports them, and no expectation is ever derived from candidate output.
collector_note: The collector allocated a contiguous CUDA tensor per case, read the data pointer, derived the vector width from the pinned can_vectorize_up_to/get_vector_size rule, called torch.nn.functional.dropout(x, p=0.1, training=True) once, and recorded the keep mask plus the CUDA generator state before and after the call.

source_files.clause: UNROLL = 4; dropout_vector_size via get_vector_size; fused_dropout_kernel_vec consumes one curand_uniform4 per VEC elements with gridxvec_loop_state starting at 0 (so VEC == 2 always takes the fresh (x, y) branch); counter_offset = ((nelem - 1) / (block_size * grid.x * UNROLL) + 1) * UNROLL
can_vectorize_up_to<T>(ptr) returns 4 when ptr is aligned to alignof(aligned_vector<T, 4>) == 4 * sizeof(T), 2 when aligned to 2 * sizeof(T), else 1; there is no 16-byte cap

cases.vec_clause: can_vectorize_up_to: 16 B alignment admits vec 4, but numel % 4 == 2 halves the width to vec 2
can_vectorize_up_to: 32 B alignment admits vec 4 for float64 (4 * sizeof(float64) == 32 B) and numel % 4 == 0; UNROLL == 4 is the only cap
can_vectorize_up_to: 32 B alignment admits vec 4 for float64, but numel % 4 == 2 halves the width to vec 2
can_vectorize_up_to: 8 B is not 16 B, so vec 4 is unavailable; 8 B alignment selects vec 2 (numel % 2 == 0)

npz_contents: keep (uint8 0/1 mask, C order, element count above), before and after (the 16-byte CUDA generator state: 8-byte seed then 8-byte Philox offset)
note: Byte-identical copies of the host recordings: the npz payloads and manifest.json keep their original bytes and SHA-256 values. This provenance file adds only relative paths and the source clauses above; it contains no absolute or private path.
